name: Harbor Roasters
description: Demonstration launch of StockFloor, a token launchpad on Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve where half of every raise becomes a redeemable floor held in tokenized S&P 500 (SPYx). Any holder can burn HRBR at any time and receive their pro-rata share of that vault, minus a 2% exit fee that stays in the vault. Harbor Roasters is a fictional coffee roastery used to demonstrate the mechanism. It is not a real business, and this token is not an investment in one. The floor protects holders from zero while the vault holds SPYx and the program is unchanged; it does not protect against loss, and its value in USD moves with the underlying index.
